reviews.title: Homely professionals
reviews.text: The service I received was heartwarming. From two of the three call center agents I talked to, to the officers at the KK International airport office, especially Penji; and the hostess on my flight made us be at home, especially the way she gave extra attention to a special attention passenger(elderly and unwell passenger) was exceptional.
reviews.author: The Tourist In Me

reviews.title: Expensive flight, reservation mishandled by airline, no baggage transfer
reviews.text: Expensive one-way flight from Livingstone to Mfuwe via Lusaka. Two days before the flight I got an email that the second leg was delayed by two hours. When I checked my reservation, the first segment (Livingstone-Lusaka) had disappeared! I contacted Proflight via Whatsapp and they apologized and rebooked the flight, but it took more Whatsapp messages before I was finally able to check in. I never got an explanation as to what happened - apparently human error. The second segment (Lusaka-Mfuwe) was then changed back to the original schedule. The Livingstone-Lusaka flight was late but there were no updates or announcements (or even monitors). Bags are not automatically transferred to connecting flights. Upon arrival in Lusaka, I had to collect my checked luggage and walk to the domestic terminal, go through security (with all my luggage) and then recheck it (for unclear reasons the check-in counters are located after security). Only then I discovered that there were no restrooms, eateries or any facilities. The Lusaka-Mfuwe flight was on time (actually early). Both aircraft were small (29- and 9-seater respectively), so the in-flight experience was what one can expect.
reviews.author: cqfp123

reviews.title: Always late
reviews.text: Proflight has no regard for timing. Their international flights always depart late. Food is also really sub-standard
reviews.author: Gazz

reviews.title: Nice short flight
reviews.text: I always love flying with Proflight as they are very affordable and you are able to get around Zambia faster than going by road. I have used them to fly to Ndola and on this trip to fly to mfuwe from Lusaka. I want to mention that Penji our Air Steward made the effort to greet everyone in their native language. Which I thought was a great touch. He had amazing customer service and was funny.
reviews.author: Monde

reviews.title: Freezing cold flight
reviews.text: My feet were freezing and I asked for help they told me that isbthe way they keep the flight temperature in check. I started having a running nose. It was really bad
reviews.author: DMC

reviews.title: What a CON!
reviews.text: I contacted Proflight to check my baggage allowance, they sent a message informing me that it was 23kg, but when we went to check in, they charged myself and my travelling companion for excess baggage, even though I had actually paid for extra as I knew I was over the 23kg! I complained and showed the supervisor the letter and she informed me that this happened everyday! I the only way she could guarantee our luggage would arrive with us was if we paid extra, otherwise she would send it free but it could arrive with the following flights. As I am disabled, I had to make sure a taxi was awaiting us at the airport in Lusaka, and I had no way to contact them, I had no option other than to pay the extra. I was told that the FIRECRACKER fare limited the baggage allowance, and that I should have booked a different flight! That is laughable as you are only offered Firecracker on the website! It's a shame Proflight have a monopoly! That said the flight crew were lovely.
reviews.author: Linda4nature

reviews.title: Worst traveling experience ever!
reviews.text: We to South Africa and were due to return to Lusaka on Sunday 27th June 2021 in readiness for work on Monday. We got to the airport at 15hrs which was a whole 3 hours ahead of departure time at 18hrs. All the while, we understood that our covid results issued by our government were valid for 15 days as stated. The airline had not bothered to inform us that these would no longer be valid as we traveled to south africa. We got to the check-in counter at 15:30 hrs where we were rudely informed that we would not make the flight because we needed new PCR tests whose results would only be out in 2 hours time and the gate would have closed by that time. Lost for words, we hurried to the testing facility where we were treated to some more abuse, never mind the exorbitant fees. We got our negative results 2 hours later at 17:28 hrs and returned to the check-in desk where we found it vacated and abandoned. It was clear that we had missed the flight, so we started calling customer care numbers to make arrangement to reschedule our return but all the numbers were unavailable. This was without doubt the worst traveling experience on an airline and certainly the worst customer care service ever! We urge all would be passengers to fly on this airline at owner's risk. Do not expect the airline or its customer care to be of any assistance should you need it.
reviews.author: Dada

reviews.title: A basic flight
reviews.text: A simple and short flight , gets bit hot and stuffy during take off , other wise good enough to get you to your destination
reviews.author: Keyur Panchal

reviews.title: Great flight friendly and professional staff members
reviews.text: Traveled to Livingstone with my husband and our 9 month old baby, i must say this was the best flight that we have ever been on. Th staff on board where very helpful , friendly and professional. We where assigned a very good seat, assisted with all our hand baggage. Looking forward to our next flight. oxoxoxo
reviews.author: Evievbwalya

reviews.title: Durban to Lusaka, return
reviews.text: Really superb. Bombardier CRJ100 jet, smaller plane, but totally comfortable and acceptable for the short haul (2 1/2 hours). Well impressed with the ground staff and the overall experience is one I'd happily repeat.
reviews.author: Dean M

reviews.title: Zambia By Pro-Flight
reviews.text: It was an amazing flight from Lusaka to Livingstone. I experienced a world class service from crew...starting from the ticket sales to the Air hosts. A best way to see Zambia from Skies is to Proflight.... theOverlanderZm
reviews.author: The Overlander zm

reviews.title: All very easy and convenient.
reviews.text: Used ProFlight a couple of times for internal flights in Zambia. I was very impressed with the service and efficiency of the airline
reviews.author: rain125

reviews.title: It was like flying in your own private jet.
reviews.text: The steward was a very friendly guy. Made us laugh quite a lot. Small air craft with few passengers. It was like you owned the aircraft. Great pilot. Smooth landing and take off. All round a very pleasant flight indeed.
reviews.author: Paddy G

reviews.title: Just Splendid
reviews.text: The direct service is so convenient, the flight attendant polite and courteous, would definitely recommend proflight Zambia to anyone looking to use them. Delightful Experience.
reviews.author: munatila s

reviews.title: Great flight
reviews.text: I must admit I was very pleasantly surprised by this experience - while it was not "Emirates" level of comfort, it was above most short-haul European flights. The crew was very nice and welcloming and friendly and even on this short haul flight (more of a hop, really) we were offered drinks and snacks. Overall, I was very happy flying with them and I will definitely use them when back in Zambia.
reviews.author: Jan B

reviews.title: Very responsive customer service
reviews.text: Flight out of Lusaka to Mfuwe and our return flight from Lilongwe to Lusaka were both on time. Flight attendants were very friendly and cheerful. Gave 4 stars because operational schedule change after we booked caused some havoc with our trip plans, however, customer service was very responsive and helpful on two separate occasions to smooth things out.
reviews.author: Joy C

reviews.title: Reliable airline
reviews.text: This was our third trip with ProFlight Zambia. Just like the first two trips, the flights were on-time, the gate agents were helpful, the flight attendants were courteous, and the pilots provided helpful information. Although the planes are small (3 seats across) they are appropriate for the distances traveled between airports in Zambia. We appreciated the reliable service which helped us to spend more time at our destinations and less time traveling between destinations.
reviews.author: BVWest2East

reviews.title: Great service for a close connection
reviews.text: Our flight from Solwezi to Mfuwe included a connecting flight in Lusaka with only 25 minutes between flights. The gate agents were expecting us and guided us through the process of retrieving our bags from the first flight, checking into the second flight, clearing security, and boarding our next flight. Everyone was courteous and helpful.
reviews.author: BVWest2East

reviews.title: On-Time Travel
reviews.text: The early morning flight from Lusaka to Solwezi was uneventful. Departed and arrived on time. The plane was small (3 seats across) but the flight was smooth. The 1 hour 10 minute flight is preferable to the long bus ride alternative
reviews.author: BVWest2East

reviews.title: Pleasant early morning flight
reviews.text: Rebecca, our stewardess made the short trip from Lusaka to Ndola a very memorable one. Being the red-eye special she thought she was going to have a quiet flight. With our noisy and demanding team on board Rebecca was kept busy but was up for the challenge and engaged with the unruly bunch. She made us laugh and made it a memorable flight
reviews.author: Tom P

reviews.title: Zambia Local Air line
reviews.text: This is the only airline that can be rely on for travel in Zambia. And the only reliable air line that can be called Zambian. However this is not the best air line for international flights. Even for the local flights the planes are very old and the flight crew is not the best. They have male flight attendants and their safety instructions cannot be heard clearly from the planes old PA system. This is the best option untill another one comes up
reviews.author: JanaWick

reviews.title: Timeliness the issue
reviews.text: The plane was a small one, everything fine but the flight was late and the airport had no information- at least it was not giving any. Many with connecting flights were all het up
reviews.author: KanwarTavy

reviews.title: Flight To Durban
reviews.text: It was a nice experience flying to Durban with the family.This is a non stop flight between lusaka and durban south African.For those who wish to visit Durban Proflight is highly recommeded
reviews.author: Thomas S

reviews.title: Unhelpful and Hot
reviews.text: Our trip to Mfuwe and then back thru Lusaka to Livingstone involved some standard small airline frustrations along with some new ones. Baggage- some how our outfitter booked different baggage allowances on each leg of a RT so we had to pay 70 dollars for one leg for excess baggage. Needless to say there was confusion and disdain for us at the various check-in desks in Lusaka. Flight- the cabin is incredibly small and in the Zambian heat of summer the planes have an ambient temperature in the 90s. It is very, very unfortable. Good thing the flights are short. Crew- we found the check-in staff particularly unhelpful but the flight stuff seemed to be motivated to move quickly despite there being little to no air traffic at any of the Zambian airports. Price- absurd but also the only option.
reviews.author: raftman10

reviews.title: Point A to B
reviews.text: Flight was OK, not too bumpy, weather ws great. Staff at Check in was very helpful. Air Hostess was very well spoken and eager to lend a hand.
reviews.author: Ashley B

reviews.title: Good, but to expensive
reviews.text: The service from staff on and off the plane was excellent. The flight can be bumpy at times due to the small size of the aircraft, but it's not too bad. My only complaint is that the fare is too steep.
reviews.author: Naomi Kakundu

reviews.title: Delayed as they could not fits all the bags !!!
reviews.text: The check in was quick and great, unfortunately we boarded the plane and had to offload us as they could not fit all the bags in the hold. surely they would have been able to judge and decide prior to asking us to board the plane.
reviews.author: Keyur Panchal

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: The great service made up for an otherwise bumpy flight, which is expected for a small plane flying in rough weather. But I need to commend the flight attendants on both legs of the trip. They go the extra mile! I could have chosen to fly with them to Cape Town ( via Durban) but their luggage allowance is limited so I opted for SAA.
reviews.author: Mukukamukulu

reviews.title: Different
reviews.text: The flight attendant and flight captain were very warm and welcoming. for the price paid i would say it is not worth it. At the check-in desk i had the boy serving me propose that i speak to him personally later to negotiate what price i could pay him to accomodate extra luggage even though i had already booked this in advance online(sister i will do it at a special price for you)this was rather disturbing. i refused. the plane itself is very squished and not comfortable and quite noisy even listening to music on ur phones with good headphones did not help to drown out the sound. other than that got to Lusaka in the specified time. i would not however be flying with them again simply because of the check-in process and the noise and sqishyness of the plane.
reviews.author: Tattianah Sabbr... T

reviews.title: Very efficient, punctual service to the copper belt
reviews.text: Needed to inspect sites in Ndola and Kitwe using the early flight (06:30) to Ndola and the last flight back. Small twin prop, comfortable and well operated.
reviews.author: UAPT

reviews.title: Good service on the flight
reviews.text: Was concerned by the size of the plane but the pilot flew well, service on the flight was foos and arrived on time.
reviews.author: Cwayita K

reviews.title: First time
reviews.text: Tried Pro flight for the first time in the June holiday . I think it's a lot quicker than having to fly from dbn to Jhb to Lusaka. I would definitely would fly with them again. I can't wait to go back to Zambia.
reviews.author: Lindy B

reviews.title: On time. No problems
reviews.text: Proflight operate some small turboprop aircraft serving internal routes, but for a 1 hour flight, they are quite adequate. Seat configuration is 1:2 Cabin crew (1) did a good job an route serving soft drinks. Staff weren't over friendly, but polite and to the point. Would use this company again.
reviews.author: Glyn F

reviews.title: Should be named couldn't care less airlines
reviews.text: We arrived late on an emirates flight and the flight had already departed. The Proflight office could not careless. They could offer us no seats and the only thing they could suggest, that we turn up at the airport each day, to see if there were any cancellations, they would not advise when any seats were available and would not issue any tickets and were told if there was a seat we would have to pay again. Whilst we could accept that it was a busy time for flights, it would have been nice to have been offered a little more courtesy and more definite information as to when any flights were available.
reviews.author: Mazagrewp

reviews.title: Close quarters
reviews.text: These are pretty small planes. The seat layout was one seat on one side of the aisle and two seats on the other side of the aisle. We flew Proflight 4 times during this trip. Each time we were given assigned seats, but only one time were we able to sit in those seats. The flight attendant told us as we boarded the plane that it was open seating. After the first flight I made a point of asking at the gate and was told it would be assigned seats, but the flight attendant again said 'open seating'. I was traveling with my husband and two sons, so this was a little stressful. Other than that though, the service was good.
reviews.author: Fisibee

reviews.title: Compact but comfortable
reviews.text: We took the Proflight from Lusaka to Mfuwe and return, the trip about 1 hour. The seating is one line of single seats and one line of double seats, 30 in total? It is quite compact and if your hand baggage does not fit under the seat in front it must go in the hold. I had two cameras in mine so they let me just hold onto them. The bag was waiting for us on the tarmac on departure of the plane. Although the journey is only 1 hour they supply you with a packet pf crisps and a drink (water/fruit juice)
reviews.author: 49Pam

reviews.title: Staff are always very pleasant
reviews.text: Pleasant & friendly staff from check in through flight duration with professional & attentive service. flight departure and arrival perfectly in accordance with schedule with email reminders days ahead
reviews.author: Jonathan V

reviews.title: Up up and away
reviews.text: Great airline left on time arrived into Zambia on time felt safe and relaxed flight crew fun and friendly
reviews.author: Jemi W

reviews.title: a tad bit overpriced
reviews.text: flying from lusaka to ndola and back costs almost the same as flying to Namibia and back. thanks to introduction of another ocal flight Mahoghany, prices have reduced although still on the higher side. a dirct flight from ndola to livingstone would be nice. at a reasonable fee ! local airlines in zambia still have a long way to go. the service is fine. Snacks one bag of lays chips . can do better esp when the competition is offering a full meal.
reviews.author: nikitapinto

reviews.title: Simple flight for short haul
reviews.text: Another small aircraft with 1-2 seating formation for a short haul. Comfy seat, simple food and friendly cabin staff
reviews.author: kiltmaker2

reviews.title: Fine Service but overpriced
reviews.text: I have no complaints about Proflight only that I have friends who live in Zambia that have pointed out to me that it's simply an overpriced airline.
reviews.author: africanman_840

reviews.title: Early flights, quick and easy
reviews.text: My daughter and I took several Proflight trips between Livingstone, Lusaka and Mfuwe airports in Zambia. Flights departed between 10 and 30 minutes early because all passengers were aboard. Passengers chose their own seats which were not allocated on these flights. All trips were comfortable. Cabin baggage trolleys needed to be checked in because of limited cabin space for storage. Luggage was promptly delivered to terminal buildings on hand trolleys after each flight.
reviews.author: dadndoc

reviews.title: Punctual and reliable
reviews.text: We used Proflight for a number of journeys - Livingstone to Lusaka to Ndola then back to Lusaka then on to Mfuwe and back to Lusaka. The flights were all on time, the staff were professional and friendly and the aircraft were comfortable, I would highly recommend using them in Zambia and beyond.
reviews.author: J H

reviews.title: Worst service I have ever received - continued!
reviews.text: So the drinks that we received were now hot! The enginerrs plane took 2 hours to arrive - because it was a light aircraft - a FIVE seater (remember Proflight already knew they had SEVEN passengers with connections!) And the baggage compartment was too small even for any suitcases! After Lusaka, we were going on to Nairobi, Mahe Johannesburg,Singapore, Sydney and Brisbane within a few days and we felt the likelihood of ever seeing our luggage again (if we left without it) was small - so we allowed others to take the seats (Being so small and heavily loaded it was estimated to artive in Lusaka AFTER our scheduled departure for Nairobi anyway) DESPITE our giving up any claim to these seats, Proflight REFUSED to help us rebook our Lusaka/Nairobi connection (to the point of refusing to even let me have a wifi Password so that I could do it myself) - in the full knowledge that without that, because of full onward flights, we risked being stranded in Nairobi for 2 days! Food was probided only when the passengers got antsy again (after the airport cafe closed up for the night) and the staff were less than happy when we all moved into the 1st class lounge, about 7pm, to escape the mosquitoes. When we had deplaned earlier that day, we were issued new BLANK boarding passes - and when we could not produce these (but showed the ORIGINAL boarding pass stubs) we were threatened with not being allowed on the 2nd replacement plane! Bureaucracy gone mad! We finally took off at 11pm - TEN HOURS late. I really have nothing good to say about this experience. A routine interruption was handled clumsily and inadequately without any regular passenger updates or rational plans to retrieve the situation or prevent resultant problems escalating
reviews.author: BarbaraMWB

reviews.title: Super Impressed with Quality of Staff
reviews.text: I wasn't sure quite what to expect but came away very impressed with the service and quality of staff. Flight was on time, announcements professional and staff friendly. Upon landing I couldn't find my wallet. The flight staff stayed on board with me, got down on their hands and knees to look under seats, and accompanied me inside to have my carry on bags sent through the x-ray machine to see if we missed it. Eventually found the wallet (so thankful!) but was very touched at their genuine concern and time.
reviews.author: CamanoIsleTraveller

reviews.title: Perfectly on time
reviews.text: We flew from Lusaka to Livingston and return. Both time we left on the minute. Was a small plane with 29 seats. One hour flight and we received a complementary drink and some crips. Would always fly with them again. Nice service. Only missing that at Livingston airport there is no sign that domestic passengers are allowed to skip the long international flights queue.
reviews.author: Nikolaus M

reviews.title: Lusaka/Kalabo/Lusaka/Mfuwe/Lusaka/Livingstone what a journey
reviews.text: We travelled from Lusaka to Kalabo and got weathered out and had to return to lusaka and try again the next day. Crew were fantastic and aircraft handled very well. Next day we made it in and then returned 4 days later to fly to Mfuwe for 9 days and then to livingstone. All of the flights were great, smooth, ontime and well serviced by the inflight steward. This is a great little airline and I wish them well with the Dash 8's coming on line. Great Canadian Aircraft.
reviews.author: piledriver

reviews.title: What a pleasure
reviews.text: What a pleasure to miss the stop over at OR Tambo. Its so much easier to fly directly to Durban especially with children in tow. The flight was on time and the staff very friendly. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Stone1013

reviews.title: Two hours and you're at the coast!
reviews.text: This flight is a fantastic one! Skipping out a stop over in O R Tambo is such a relief..... Small plane, attentive staff and stunning views along the way. Keep these flights going!
reviews.author: Dorothy M

reviews.title: Direct flight, Durban to Lusaka
reviews.text: Normally flying commercial airlines into the rest of Africa from Durban includes a couple of hour stopover at OR Tambo (Jhb) to catch connecting flights. Flew up to Zambia on a direct flight on a Sunday with Proflight. Very pleasant. A smaller plane meant a quicker turnaround through customs with no long queues (on either side).
reviews.author: Trevor S
